newsitem.title: GREECE: INTRACOM CONSTRUCTION ISSUED ISO 9002 CERTIFICATE.
newsitem.headline: INTRACOM CONSTRUCTION ISSUED ISO 9002 CERTIFICATE.

text.p: Intracom Construction was conferred an ISO 9002 quality certificate on June 23 1997 by the Bureau Veritas Quality International, it said in a statement.
"The certification constitutes an important advantage for Intracom Construction over the competition for private and public works," it said.

Intracom Construction, a 95 percent subsidiary of Greece's high-tech telecom manufacturer Intracom , is engaged in telecoms and energy-related engineering projects for the private and the public sector.
Its 1996 pretax profit reached 400 million drachmas on turnover of 2.865 billion. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
